title: Ruflo Report — Canonical Schema
description: Required fields for every report artifact in reports/. Validator: scripts/validate_reports.py

report_format_version.description: Schema version. Increment when required fields change.

name.description: Stable machine identifier for this report. Matches filename stem.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the report was generated (UTC preferred).

database_url_set.description: True when DATABASE_URL (non-test) was present and non-empty at runtime.

test_database_url_set.description: True when TEST_DATABASE_URL pointed to a real PostgreSQL instance.

collected.description: Total items evaluated (tests, checks, criteria, contracts, etc.).

exit_code.description: Process exit code. 0 = pass, non-zero = fail/error.

blockers.description: List of active blockers derived from this report.

known_limitations.description: Active KL entries relevant to this report (array or registry object).

_notes: additionalProperties:true — existing report fields are preserved.
collected = passed + failed + errors + skipped is NOT enforced here because
some reports use different counting (e.g. RC criteria vs test counts).
Report files are normalized in-place by scripts/validate_reports.py --normalize.
